mapper.select: SELECT id, agent_id AS agentId, mode_name AS modeName, mode_code AS modeCode, system_prompt AS systemPrompt, is_default AS isDefault, sort, create_date AS createDate FROM ai_agent_mode WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} ORDER BY sort ASC

SELECT id, agent_id AS agentId, mode_name AS modeName, mode_code AS modeCode, system_prompt AS systemPrompt, is_default AS isDefault, sort FROM ai_agent_mode WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND is_default = 1 LIMIT 1
